Olivia Rodrigo's first Christmas song "take me home (4 christmas)" debuted at No.8 on Spotify's US daily chart with 765,495 streams on day one (Nov 6, 2026).

That put it above Wham! "Last Christmas" (No.12) and Mariah Carey "All I Want for Christmas Is You" (No.16) on the same chart. In the UK it entered at No.12, three spots above Last Christmas; globally it debuted at No.42. Mariah's song has now spent 606 days on the US daily chart; Olivia's has one.

Written with Dan Nigro and Amy Allen and produced by Nigro, it's her first original holiday single.

New Christmas classic, or a one-season wonder?

Data: Spotify daily charts US, UK and global via kworb · Nov 6, 2026
